opinions.text:
Per Curiam:
Mr. Joshua Fields appeals a Jackson County Circuit Court judgment denying his Rule 29.15 motion for post-conviction relief claiming ineffective assistance of counsel. For reasons stated in the memorandum provided to the parties, we affirm. Rule 84.16(b).
